# SHARED dependency set for every lab that runs the local language model:
# labs 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7.
#
# THIS FILE IS COPIED VERBATIM INTO EACH OF THOSE LABS. Do not edit one lab's copy.
# The layer it produces is only shared between labs if the file is byte-identical,
# and sharing it is worth ~50 MB of download per lab. If a lab needs a new package,
# add it HERE and rebuild the whole tier.
#
# llama-cpp-python==0.3.35 is deliberately NOT listed. It ships no PyPI wheels, so it
# is installed from the prebuilt wheel in Activity-Labs/wheels/ - see the Dockerfile
# and wheels/build-wheels.sh. Pinning it in two places would let them drift apart.
#
# torch is NOT here. llama.cpp runs the model; nothing in labs 3-7 imports torch, and
# adding it would cost ~250 MB for nothing. Labs 1 and 2 have their own file.

numpy==2.3.5
huggingface-hub==1.31.0

# Image work: lab 4 renders the invoices and stamps. Carried by the whole tier so the
# layer stays identical across labs - about 10 MB for labs that do not use it, which
# is the price of sharing the other 40.
pillow==11.3.0
